snippets.INTRO_CROWDNPC_01: Hey everyone, look! The new Panda just soaked Ella. Nice shot!
snippets.INTRO_ELLA_01: Help! I'm drowning! What? Who? Oh, a new Panda. I bet that was your idea, Max!
snippets.INTRO_ELLA_02: Thanks for the shower, Max! How about a little gift? Just for you!
snippets.INTRO_MAX_01: Whoa, where did you come from? I didn't know pandas could fly!
snippets.INTRO_MAX_02: You're right on time! My friend Manny and I are putting the final touches on your treehouse.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_03: Come a bit closer so you can hear me better. Just click on the circle to walk.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_04: Nice! Now try jumping: double-click the left mouse button.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_05: Great work! Let's explore more of the world of Panfu.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_06: Feel like pulling a prank? My friend Ella is napping in the City right now. Let's wake her up!
snippets.INTRO_MAX_07: Click on the map to travel to a new location.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_08: Welcome to the City! It's one of many locations you can visit with the map. Just as I thought, Ella is napping.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_09: Let's wake her up! She could use some cooling down. Select ACTIONS and throw a red WATER BALLOON at Ella.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_10: Why don't you all say "Hi" to our new Panda.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_11: You can reply by typing "Hello" into the chat box.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_12: When you're done, press the Enter key on your keyboard to send the message.
snippets.INTRO_MAX_13: And remember: always be nice when chatting with other Pandas!
snippets.INTRO_MAX_14: It was great meeting you! I'm sure you'll see Ella and me again soon. Have fun and see you later!
